#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int maxCuttings(vector<int>& arr, int b) {
    vector<int> costs;
    int numEvens = (arr[0] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    int numOdds = (arr[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
    int numCuttings = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
        if (numOdds == numEvens && abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]) <= b) {
            numEvens = 0;
            numOdds = 0;
            costs.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]));
        }
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) ++numEvens;
        else ++numOdds;
    }
    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    for (int i = 0; i < costs.size(); i++) {
        if (b < costs[i])
            break;
        ++numCuttings;
        b -= costs[i];
    }
    return numCuttings;
}

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }
    cout << maxCuttings(arr, b) << endl;
    return 0;
}
